Generated Narrative: CodeSystem pcmt-glossary

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/pcmt/CodeSystem/pcmt-glossary defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
unit-of-use Unit of UseSmallest unit of a product that can be administered or dispensed to a patient (handbook Fig 11, p.31).
unitOfUse Unit of Use (camelCase alias)Smallest unit of a product that can be administered or dispensed to a patient (handbook Fig 11, p.31).
dosageForm Dosage FormPhysical form in which a pharmaceutical product is produced and dispensed, such as tablet, capsule, or injectable solution.
routeOfAdministration Route of AdministrationPath by which a health product is taken into the body, such as oral, intravenous, or topical.
strength StrengthAmount of active ingredient per unit of use, such as 500mg per tablet or 10mg/mL.
shelfLife Shelf LifeLength of time a health product may be stored without becoming unfit for use, consumption, or sale.
storageHandling Storage and HandlingConditions required to maintain product quality during storage and transport, such as temperature range or light protection.

name: PCMTGlossary
title: PCMT Glossary Terms
description: CodeSystem for product attributes and terminology used in the SMART Product Catalogue Management Tool (PCMT). Core domain entities (Generic Product, Trade Item, Regulated Trade Item, Product Master Data) are anchored in the mounted dth-pc glossary (https://litlfred.github.io/dth-pc/v0/ns#glossary/dth-pc/).
